text: The dimensional formula of angular momentum is:
explanation: Angular momentum L = mvr = [M][LT⁻¹][L] = [ML²T⁻¹]. Same dimensions as Planck's constant h.
trick: Angular momentum = Planck's constant in dimensions. Both are [ML²T⁻¹].

text: A body starts from rest, acceleration 4 m/s². Distance in 3rd second is:
trick: Sₙ = u + a(2n−1)/2. Very frequently asked in NEET.

text: Work done by centripetal force on circular motion:
explanation: F ⊥ displacement → W = Fd cos90° = 0.
trick: Force perpendicular to displacement → W=0. Centripetal, Normal on horizontal → zero work.

explanation: ve = √(2gR) ≈ 11.2 km/s. ve = √2 × orbital velocity.
trick: ve = 11.2 km/s. Orbital vo = 7.9 km/s. ve = √2 × vo.

text: Moment of inertia of uniform disc about diameter:
explanation: By perpendicular axis theorem: MR²/2 = 2I_diameter → I = MR²/4.
trick: Disc about center = MR²/2. Divide by 2 for diameter = MR²/4.

text: Time period of simple pendulum depends on:
explanation: T = 2π√(L/g). Independent of mass and amplitude (small oscillations).
trick: T = 2π√(L/g). On moon: T increases (g smaller).

text: In isothermal process for ideal gas:
explanation: T = constant → ΔU = 0 → Q = W.
trick: Isothermal: ΔU=0. Isobaric: P same. Isochoric: V same → W=0. Adiabatic: Q=0.

text: Electric field inside a hollow conducting sphere:
explanation: By Gauss's law, no enclosed charge → E = 0 inside conductor.
trick: Inside conductor = E is ZERO always. Charges on outer surface.

text: Charged particle moves parallel to B. Magnetic force:
explanation: F = qvBsinθ. θ=0° (parallel) → F=0.
trick: Parallel to B → F=0. Perpendicular to B → F=max=qvB.

explanation: Induced current opposes change to conserve energy.
trick: Lenz = Energy conservation in EM form.

explanation: Photons (E=hν) cannot be explained by wave theory → particle nature.
trick: Photoelectric → particle. Diffraction/Interference → wave.

text: Bohr's model: radius of nth orbit proportional to:
explanation: rn = n²a₀/Z. rn ∝ n².
trick: Radius ∝ n². Energy ∝ 1/n². Velocity ∝ 1/n. Angular momentum ∝ n.

text: Horizontal range is maximum when angle is:
explanation: R = u²sin2θ/g. Max when sin2θ=1 → θ=45°.
trick: Max range at 45°. Equal range at complementary angles (30°=60°).

text: Excess pressure inside soap bubble of radius r, surface tension T:
explanation: Two surfaces → 4T/r. Single surface (drop): 2T/r.
trick: Bubble (2 surfaces): 4T/r. Drop/air bubble in liquid (1 surface): 2T/r.

text: In Young's double slit experiment, fringe width depends on:
explanation: β = λD/d. Fringe width ∝ λ (wavelength) and D (screen distance), inversely ∝ d (slit separation).
trick: β = λD/d. Increase λ or D → wider fringes. Increase d → narrower fringes.

explanation: sp³, 2 bond pairs + 2 lone pairs → bent. Bond angle 104.5°.
trick: H₂O=bent(104.5°), NH₃=trigonal pyramidal(107°), CH₄=tetrahedral(109.5°).

text: ΔH<0 and ΔS<0. Reaction is spontaneous:
explanation: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS. At low T, TΔS small → ΔG negative → spontaneous.
trick: ΔH− ΔS− → low T. ΔH+ ΔS+ → high T. Use ΔG = ΔH − TΔS.

explanation: 4 moles gas → 2 moles. Higher P → fewer moles side (right) → more NH₃.
trick: High P → fewer moles side. Haber process uses this.

text: Half-life of first order reaction is independent of:
explanation: t½ = 0.693/k. Depends on k but NOT on initial concentration.
trick: First order: t½ = 0.693/k (concentration independent). Zero order: t½ depends on [A₀].

explanation: Acid strength ∝ 1/(H-X bond strength). Bond strength F>Cl>Br>I. So HI > HBr > HCl > HF.
trick: HI strongest acid. HF weakest acid but strongest bond. Electronegativity ≠ acid strength.

explanation: More alkyl groups → more hyperconjugation → more stable.
trick: Carbocation stability: 3°>2°>1°>methyl. Carbanion: reverse. Radical: 3°>2°>1°.

explanation: SN2 = backside attack = Walden inversion. 180° approach.
trick: SN2 = backside = inversion. SN1 = carbocation = racemization. 3° prefers SN1.

text: Test that distinguishes aldehydes from ketones:
explanation: Tollens (ammoniacal AgNO₃) → silver mirror with aldehydes only.
trick: Tollens=silver mirror=aldehyde. Iodoform=CHI₃=CH₃CO- group.

explanation: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) → collagen synthesis. Deficiency = scurvy.
trick: A=Night blindness, B₁=Beriberi, C=Scurvy, D=Rickets, K=Bleeding.

explanation: "6,6" = 6 carbons in each monomer (diamine + diacid).
trick: Nylon-6,6=2 monomers(6C each). Nylon-6=caprolactam. Dacron=glycol+terephthalic acid.

text: Elevation of boiling point is a _________ property:
explanation: Colligative properties depend on number of solute particles, not their nature: ΔTb, ΔTf, osmotic pressure, relative lowering of VP.
trick: 4 colligative properties: ΔTb, ΔTf, osmotic pressure, relative lowering of VP. All depend on number of particles.

text: Which organelle is the "powerhouse of the cell"?
explanation: Mitochondria produce ATP via oxidative phosphorylation. Inner membrane = cristae.
trick: Mito=powerhouse. Ribosome=protein factory. Golgi=post office. Lysosome=suicidal bag.

text: Which is NOT a reducing sugar?
explanation: Sucrose: glycosidic bond between anomeric carbons of both → no free reducing group.
trick: Non-reducing: Sucrose, Trehalose. All monosaccharides = reducing. Most disaccharides = reducing EXCEPT sucrose.

explanation: Meselson-Stahl (1958): each daughter DNA has one parental + one new strand.
trick: Semi = half old, half new. Proved by Meselson-Stahl using ¹⁵N/¹⁴N.

text: Crossing over occurs at which stage of meiosis:
explanation: Crossing over at Pachytene of Prophase I. Chiasmata visible at Diplotene.
trick: LZPDD: Leptotene, Zygotene, Pachytene (crossing over!), Diplotene, Diakinesis.

explanation: Kranz anatomy: CO₂ concentrated in bundle sheath → rubisco works efficiently.
trick: C4=Corn/Sugarcane/Sorghum. Kranz anatomy+CO₂ pump=no photorespiration.

text: Site of light reactions in chloroplast:
explanation: Light reactions: thylakoid membranes. Calvin cycle (dark): stroma.
trick: Light=Thylakoid. Dark (Calvin)=Stroma. Remember L-T, D-S.

explanation: Glycolysis in cytoplasm. No O₂ needed. 1 glucose → 2 pyruvate + 2 ATP (net).
trick: Glycolysis=Cytoplasm. Krebs=Mitochondrial matrix. ETC=Inner mitochondrial membrane.

explanation: Auxin from shoot apex suppresses lateral bud growth.
trick: Auxin=apical dominance. Cytokinin=lateral growth (opposes auxin). Gibberellin=stem elongation.

explanation: Chief (peptic) cells → pepsinogen → pepsin (activated by HCl). Parietal/oxyntic cells → HCl.
trick: Chief=pepsinogen. Parietal=HCl+Intrinsic factor. Goblet=mucus. G-cells=gastrin.

explanation: SA node (right atrium): 70-75 bpm, natural pacemaker.
trick: SA node=pacemaker=right atrium. AV=40-60 bpm backup. His/Purkinje=20-40 bpm.

explanation: Nephron = structural + functional unit. ~1 million per kidney.
trick: Nephron=kidney unit. Neuron=nerve unit. Sarcomere=muscle unit.

text: Myelin sheath in PNS produced by:
explanation: PNS: Schwann cells. CNS: Oligodendrocytes. Astrocytes=structural. Microglia=immune.
trick: PNS myelin=Schwann. CNS myelin=Oligodendrocytes. Schwann also helps nerve regeneration.

text: ABO blood group is example of:
explanation: 3 alleles (Iᴬ,Iᴮ,i) = multiple allelism. AB group = codominance.
trick: ABO=codominance+multiple allelism. Sickle cell=codominance. 4 o'clock plant=incomplete dominance.

explanation: Transcription: DNA→RNA. Translation: RNA→Protein. Reverse transcription: RNA→DNA (retroviruses).
trick: DNA→RNA→Protein. HIV uses reverse transcriptase for RNA→DNA.

explanation: 5 conditions: large population, random mating, no mutation, no selection, no gene flow.
trick: p²+2pq+q²=1. Five conditions for equilibrium. Violations = evolution occurring.

explanation: 10% law: only 10% energy transferred upward. Always upright — thermodynamics.
trick: Energy=ALWAYS upright (10% law). Biomass=usually upright. Number=any shape.

explanation: In-situ=natural habitat: National parks, sanctuaries, biosphere reserves.
trick: In-situ=in place=National park. Ex-situ=out of place=Zoo, seed bank.

explanation: Acrosome=Golgi body. Contains hyaluronidase for egg penetration.
trick: Acrosome=Golgi. Middle piece=mitochondria (energy). Tail=flagellum.

explanation: Cut specific palindromic sequences. EcoRI cuts GAATTC.
trick: Restriction enzymes=molecular scissors. Palindrome reads same on both strands 5'→3'.

explanation: Bt toxin activated in alkaline insect gut → pores in midgut epithelium → lysis.
trick: Bt toxin=pro-toxin → activated in alkaline pH → pores in midgut → death. Safe for mammals.

explanation: Ciliated columnar epithelium in trachea. Cilia sweep mucus upward.
trick: Trachea=ciliated (sweeps mucus up). Alveoli=squamous (thin for gas exchange). Intestine=columnar.

text: Double fertilization is a characteristic of:
explanation: Double fertilization: unique to angiosperms. One sperm+egg=zygote. Other sperm+2 polar nuclei=endosperm (3n).
trick: Double fertilization=ONLY angiosperms. Siphonogamy=gymnosperms. Zygote+endosperm formed.

opt_b: Ability of cell to develop into complete organism
explanation: Totipotency: single cell can develop into complete organism. Basis of tissue culture. All cells have complete genome.
trick: Totipotent=total potential. Every cell has complete DNA. Basis of cloning and tissue culture.
